name: Robert Christopher Haugland Lindqvist
extra_bullets: Chaired the company's sustainability working group and set targets for recycled content and shipping emissions
Ran the yearly supplier review with purchasing and quality, ending contracts with five suppliers who missed targets
Wrote the standard operating procedures for both warehouses after a safety audit
Represented supply planning in the plant's monthly cost reduction meeting
Trained new dispatchers on the load tracking system
cover_letter_paragraph: I also spend a lot of time developing people. Three of the planners I hired at Lakeport now lead their own teams, and at Tennwick I started a rotation program that moves analysts between planning, purchasing and logistics. Supply chain teams work better when people understand the whole flow, not just their own piece.

extra_reference.name: Michelle Arndt
extra_reference.relationship: Plant leader I work with every week
